Latin word

hūmānus

hūmānus, hūmāna, hūmānum

declension

human; cultivated, refined, civilized; humane, kind; cultivated, refined; human, of people

In this lexicon

  • civilized

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 150, 157; Cic. Div. 1.2: gentem quidem nūllam videō neque tam hūmānam atque doctam neque tam immānem atque barbaram (Lewis & Short); Traupman 291

  • compassionate

    also used · classical · Traupman 150, 154, 157

  • human

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Heaut. 77: hūmānī nihil ā mē aliēnum putō; Liv. 21.30.7: hūmānō generī; Plin. NH 8.1: proximumque hūmānīs sēnsibus; Traupman 330

Examples

  • Homō sum: hūmānī nihil ā mē aliēnum putō.

    I am human: I count nothing human foreign to me.Ter. Heaut. 77

  • nūllās profectō terrās caelum contingere nec inexsuperābilēs hūmānō generī esse

    no land actually touches the sky, and none is beyond the human race to crossLiv. 21.30.7
